assumptions: The API does not perform any input validation.

cases.objective: Test if a user can buy more tickets than allowed per order.
cases.expected_behaviour: The API should reject the request because the user is trying to buy more than 10 tickets in a single order.
cases.potential_vulnerability: Limit enforcement per-request but not per-user or per-lifetime
cases.reason: The API does not enforce a limit on the number of tickets a user can buy in a single order, allowing a user to exceed the maximum allowed.

cases.objective: Test if a user can use a coupon to bypass the maximum ticket limit.
cases.expected_behaviour: The API should reject the request because the user is trying to buy more than 10 tickets in a single order, even with a coupon.
cases.potential_vulnerability: Limit enforcement per-request but not per-user or per-lifetime
cases.reason: The API does not enforce a limit on the number of tickets a user can buy in a single order, even with a coupon.

cases.objective: Test if a user can use a coupon to bypass the maximum ticket limit and earn more credits.
